release_slices.plain_english_purpose: Restore IMS and POS DGFY cashier/user invitation search when session refresh fails but the current browser still has a valid tenant user bearer token.
release_slices.purpose: Restore IMS and POS DGFY cashier/user invitation search when session refresh fails but the current browser still has a valid tenant user bearer token.
release_slices.implementation_summary: The shared API interceptor no longer drops the already-present bearer token when the tenant-context preflight refresh returns an error. This lets the backend derive tenant context from the authenticated user for DGFY account-search/invite requests instead of receiving an unauthenticated tenantless request.

release_slices.regression_warning_summary: This changes shared browser-session request behavior. A regression could affect authenticated IMS/POS requests when refresh-token fails, but the intended behavior is conservative: preserve an existing bearer token rather than omitting it.
